KycCaseOpeningSubscriber.//TransientRetryMaxDelaySeconds: DEVELOPMENT: a message waiting for a dependency is retried at least every 10 s (production: 60, appsettings.json), so an API reopened at the fault proxy - or restarted - is used again within seconds and the saga's reply timers are not outrun.
KycCaseOpeningSubscriber.//KycApiBaseUrl: Development: through the fault proxy (route customer-kyc-api, ps/toxiproxy/toxiproxy.json), so operations can cut it on Simulator & Fault Controls. appsettings.json holds the API's own address, used everywhere else.
KycCaseOpeningSubscriber.//ClientKey: DEVELOPMENT: this worker's private_key_jwt key and the key its tokens are bound to (DPoP), made by ps/pki/New-EwpLocalPki.ps1 (outside the repository); elsewhere both are mounted from a secret store.
